## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
      (`feat`, `fix`, `docs`, ... with a plugin-name or area scope).
- [ ] I did **not** manually bump versions or edit generated changelogs —
      release-please handles that on merge to `main`.
- [ ] New/changed plugins have `CONTEXT.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and a valid
      `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`.
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes locally.
- [ ] Shell changes have or update a `bats` test under `scripts/tests/`.
